title: It Takes a Team: Celebrating Cobb County's Election Heroes - Cobb County (.gov)
text:
It Takes a Team: Celebrating Cobb County's Election Heroes | Cobb County Georgia Skip to main content Translate News Events Translate News Celebrating Cobb County's Election Heroes It Takes a Team: Celebrating Cobb County's Election Heroes
 Share: Thursday, October 22, 2026
 Every election depends on the people who make it happen. During Advance Voting, more than 530 election workers are staffing 13 locations across Cobb County for the November 3, 2026, General Election/Special Election.
 On the front lines of the voting process, these workers welcome voters, assist with check-in and help keep operations running smoothly. Throughout the 21-day Advance Voting cycle, they dedicate their time and energy to serving voters. Since Advance Voting began October 13, more than 117,000 voters have cast their ballots across the county.
 On October 22, Cobb County Elections & Registration staff visited all 13 Advance Voting locations to deliver sweet treats as a small token of appreciation for workers' continued hard work and dedication.
 The dedication of our Advance Voting workers is one part of the coordinated effort it takes to conduct an election. On Election Day, 1,700+ election workers will serve voters at 132 polling locations across Cobb County. Behind the scenes, full-time and part-time department staff work year-round to coordinate logistics, prepare voting locations, organize equipment and supplies, develop training materials, and ensure workers have the resources they need to serve voters. This ongoing preparation helps keep election operations organized and running smoothly from Advance Voting through Election Day.
 Recognizing Our Election Heroes 
 National Election Hero Day recognizes the people whose time, preparation and service help make elections possible.
 To our Advance Voting workers, Election Day workers and Elections & Registration staff: Thank you for your dedication, professionalism and continued commitment to serving our community.
 You are election heroes every day, and your work is appreciated all year long. 
 Interested in becoming a Cobb County election worker? Visit the Election Day Poll Worker Jobs webpage to learn more about opportunities to serve.
